authority: This file is the runtime authority for football player-prop engine availability. It declares implemented code paths only. Artifact/evidence readiness is derived at runtime from the bound registries and is never hard-coded here. A frozen artifact alone does not create an executable probability engine. Provider markets under implemented_provider_markets apply only to sports whose engine_state is IMPLEMENTED_FAIL_CLOSED; sports declared NO_ENGINE retain explicit NO_ENGINE until an independently validated probability engine is promoted into this runtime surface.

CFB.reason: CFB props remain NO_ENGINE until a genuine probability engine independently validates; frozen training artifacts are research inputs only and have no promotion authority.

explicit_no_engine.targets: No standard bound provider player-targets settlement market is on this acquisition surface.
explicit_no_engine.first_td: First scorer requires complete sport-specific return-score and overtime scorer ordering plus player identity before it can join the provider surface.
explicit_no_engine.last_td: Last scorer requires complete sport-specific return-score and overtime scorer ordering plus player identity before it can join the provider surface.
explicit_no_engine.returner_td_identity: Kickoff/punt return scoring exists structurally but returner identity is not yet a production player-prop identity surface.
explicit_no_engine.team_defensive_props: Team sacks/turnovers are derivable from the defensive path but no bound provider market/acquisition key is declared.
explicit_no_engine.cfb_player_props: All CFB player props are NO_ENGINE until a genuine CFB probability engine independently validates and is explicitly promoted into the runtime surface.
